entities.name: Ampin C&I Power Thirty Private Limited

industry: Commodities > Construction Materials > Cement & Cement Products

operating_notes.text: Acquired 26% stake in Ampin C&I Power SPV for ₹30.60 Cr for captive wind-solar hybrid power in Karnataka.
Total grey cement capacity crossed 200 MTPA in April 2026.
Birla Opus reached 11,500 towns and 50,000 dealers in Q4 FY26.
Birla Pivot delivered to over 5,000 pin codes across more than 400 cities.
Approved ₹3,094 Cr capex for Phase II Lyocell capacity of 110K TPA at Harihar, Karnataka, with commissioning slated for mid-2028 and mid-2030.
Grey cement capacity (India and overseas) rose 8.7 MTPA to 205.5 MTPA; domestic realisation ₹5,218/t, up 1% YoY.
Specialty fibre share of CSF sales volume rose to 27% from 21% in Q1FY26; CSF volumes fell 4% YoY to 202 KT.
Standalone FY27 capex plan is ₹3,157 Cr, of which ₹375 Cr was spent in Q1FY27.
Commenced commercial production of 50K TPA Epichlorohydrin (ECH) plant at Vilayat, Gujarat, strengthening downstream chlor-alkali portfolio.

timeline.summary: NCLAT set aside the CCI's ₹301.61 Cr penalty order and remanded the matter for fresh hearing on 5 May 2026
Grasim Industries approved the acquisition of a 26% stake in Ampin C&I Power Thirty Private Limited for ₹30.60 Cr to secure captive renewable power in Karnataka.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹51,101.11 Cr (+15.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹1,957.74 Cr.
Grasim Industries reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹51,101 Cr (+15% YoY) and net profit of ₹3,802 Cr (+28% YoY).
Grasim Industries approved a ₹2,880 Cr preferential equity investment in subsidiary Aditya Birla Capital as part of a ₹4,000 Cr capital raise.
Neelabja Chakrabarty, ACS, shared the earnings call audio for Q4FY26 results on grasim.com, dated 20th May 2026.
Grasim hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on 20 May 2026, highlighting growth in Birla Opus paints, Birla Pivot B2B e-commerce, and UltraTech capacity.
Birla Group Holdings Private Limited, as Grasim Industries Limited’s promoter, declared no new encumbrances for FY2026 on June 2, 2026.
Grasim approved ₹3,094 Cr capex for 110K TPA Lyocell Phase II capacity expansion at Harihar, Karnataka.
Grasim commenced commercial production at its 50K TPA Epichlorohydrin (ECH) plant at Vilayat, Gujarat on 21 October 2026.
Exchange sought clarification on news of Bombay HC quashing ₹329 Cr tax claim against Grasim.
The Bombay High Court quashed a ₹329 Cr tax reassessment notice against Grasim related to its participation in the FY2020 Vodafone Idea rights issue.
